ui.chat.aside.adopt.confirm: Press {cap} again to add the aside to the conversation. Once added, it stays there.
ui.chat.aside.adopt.failed: The aside was not added to the conversation.
ui.chat.aside.adopt.not_landed: The aside was not added to the conversation. Add it again to try once more.
ui.chat.aside.adopt.queued: Queued — this aside joins the conversation when the current turn finishes.
ui.chat.aside.adopt.refused.open_tool_ba: The conversation stopped in the middle of a tool call, so the aside was not added. Send a message to continue the conversation, then add the aside.
ui.chat.aside.adopt.refused.session_clos: The aside was not added: this conversation has closed, so there is nothing to add it to.
ui.chat.aside.adopt.refused.turn_running: This conversation is busy, and the version it's running can't queue an aside. Add it when the reply finishes.
ui.chat.aside.adopt.unconfirmed: The aside could not be confirmed in the conversation. If it is not there, add it again.
ui.chat.aside.ask_busy: The aside is still answering. Press Enter again once the answer is in.
ui.chat.aside.ask_queued: This aside is queued to join the conversation. Ask again once it has been added.
ui.chat.aside.blocked.settling: The exchange is still settling — a moment before it can be added.
ui.chat.aside.blocked.working: This conversation is working. Adding the aside while it runs would splice a message into a live turn.
ui.chat.aside.continuation_escape: This aside can't continue. Press Esc to close it, which discards this exchange, then start a new one with /btw.
ui.chat.aside.declined_options: Ask again here to keep this exchange, or press Esc to close the aside and discard it.
ui.chat.aside.model_no_text: The model didn't reply in text. Ask again.
